groupings.title: Quick start
groupings.description: Start here. The umbrella skill routes user questions to the right specialized skill below; vike-core covers install and auth; vike-daily-brief is a cheap cross-market rundown.

groupings.title: Tokens
groupings.description: Resolve, screen, and research tokens on Ethereum, BSC, Base and HyperEVM. Smart-money inflow and its trend over time (Ethereum), holders and holder due diligence, top buyers and sellers.

groupings.title: Wallets
groupings.description: Who a wallet is, per-wallet profile, flows, counterparty graphs, incident tracing, relatedness evidence, ENS, batch labelling, label provenance, on Ethereum, BSC, Base and HyperEVM.

groupings.title: CEX perps
groupings.description: Funding-rate arb and per-symbol venue comparison, cross-venue perp price gaps, open interest and long/short lean per venue, and a crowding read that nets open interest against price.

groupings.title: Hyperliquid perps
groupings.description: Top traders and leaderboards, one-wallet profiles, wallet-cohort positioning and its backtest method, single-symbol briefings, liquidation risk, builder codes, and share-card reverse-lookup.

groupings.title: Candles
groupings.description: Historical OHLCV for Hyperliquid perp/spot markets and Polymarket outcome tokens.

groupings.title: Polymarket
groupings.description: Prediction-market discovery, single-market deep-dives and due diligence (order book, tape, trades with wallets, holders, on-chain settlement), trader profiles, smart-money signals, and the free L2 Parquet archive.

groupings.title: Predict.fun
groupings.description: Prediction markets on BNB Chain: the venue at a glance, markets by 24h volume, one market's outcomes, order book and on-chain fills with wallets, a wallet's positions and P&L, and the wallet leaderboard.

groupings.title: Alerts
groupings.description: Create, list, edit, delete transfer alerts (a token or one wallet, USD thresholds) and Hyperliquid alerts; read what fired; HTTPS webhooks with HMAC delivery.

groupings.title: Live streams
groupings.description: Hyperliquid, HL cohort, on-chain and Polymarket events as they happen over WebSocket, as NDJSON, resumed by cursor.
